player_intro: (DeckTech handle '''Ooryl_909''') posted a [[Light]] list on DeckTech in May 2001.
description: My newest version TRM teched out and ready for tatooine.  Uses Twix's for activation, Heading for the Med. Frigate Start and tracking for great retrieval.
cards: posted: Heading for the Med Frigate
posted: I Hope She's All Right
notes: Posted 27 May 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

No objective and no starting section. The description names Heading For The Medical Frigate as the start (it is in the Interrupts and counts toward the 60); no starting location or single starting Effect is named, so none is set.

The strategy says the deck went 2-1 at the Wisconsin state championship (WI states), its only loss to Christian Kriesel's Hunt Down deck (by 17, corrected in an update to 14). An update says the states version used Insurrection/Staging Areas and this version uses Twi'leks instead.

Posted 'Chewie Protecta' dested Chewbacca, Protector; 'RS1' Red Squadron 1; 'Orrimarrko' Orrimaarko; 'Fall of a Legend' Fall Of The Legend; 'Clash' Clash Of Sabers; 'Ani's Saber' Anakin's Lightsaber; 'Squassin' Squadron Assignments; 'Owen and Beru' Owen Lars & •Beru Lars.

Posted 'Lando w/ Ax', 'Luke w/ Saber', 'Leia w/ Blaster', 'Han w/ Blaster' and 'Obi w/ Saber' dested the Light Enhanced characters Lando With Vibro-Ax, Luke With Lightsaber, Leia With Blaster Rifle, Han With Heavy Blaster Pistol and Obi-Wan With Lightsaber.

Posted 'Cantina' dested the Light Tatooine: Cantina; 'Yavin 4 Throne Room' Yavin 4: Massassi Throne Room; 'Echo Command Center' Hoth: Echo Command Center (War Room); 'OOC/TT' and 'Control/Tunnel' the Light combo interrupts; 'YISYW' and 'Aim High' are posted alone and dested the single cards (the update says the Insurrection/Staging Areas version was dropped).
player_note: The strategy says the deck went 2-1 at the 2001 Wisconsin State Championship; a later update says the list was changed afterwards (the states version used Insurrection/Staging Areas, this one uses Twi'leks for activation), so the posted list differs from what was played.
